title: Sun Kil Moon: The Band
description: Mark Kozelek's long-running project: from Red House Painters' slowcore to the diary-like songs of Benji.

cards.prompt: Which singer-songwriter is behind Sun Kil Moon?
cards.details: Sun Kil Moon is essentially Kozelek's project, with a changing cast of musicians around him.

cards.prompt: Which band did Mark Kozelek lead before Sun Kil Moon?
cards.details: A pioneering slowcore band: long, slow, melancholy songs that sound like grey weather.

cards.prompt: Red House Painters were based in which Californian city?
cards.details: They came up in the late-'80s and early-'90s San Francisco scene.

cards.prompt: Which British label, famous for its atmospheric sound, signed Red House Painters?
cards.details: The home of Cocteau Twins and Pixies. Red House Painters fitted its moody aesthetic perfectly.

cards.prompt: The name Sun Kil Moon comes from a professional in which sport?
cards.details: It's a nod to the Korean boxer Sung-Kil Moon. Kozelek is a big boxing fan and often writes about fighters.

cards.prompt: What is Sun Kil Moon's 2003 debut album?
cards.details: A fan favourite, mixing gentle folk with long, crunchy electric guitar workouts.

cards.prompt: Which much-loved Ghosts of the Great Highway song asks to be carried back to Kozelek's home state?
cards.details: A wistful song of home and regret, often named among his very best.

cards.prompt: In which Ohio town did Mark Kozelek grow up?
cards.details: Ohio and its small towns come up again and again in his lyrics.

cards.prompt: Sun Kil Moon's 2005 album Tiny Cities is made up entirely of covers of which band?
cards.details: A link to the Modest Mouse sets! Kozelek turns Isaac Brock's twitchy songs into slow, hushed acoustic ballads.

cards.prompt: What is the name of Mark Kozelek's own record label?
cards.details: Named after a Portuguese soup. Sun Kil Moon releases have mostly come out on it.

cards.prompt: Which 2008 Sun Kil Moon album shares its name with a spring month?
cards.details: A long, sorrowful, mostly acoustic record, and one of his most loved.

cards.prompt: Admiral Fell Promises (2010) is built almost entirely around which instrument?
cards.details: Kozelek plays intricate fingerpicked nylon-string guitar throughout, with almost nothing else.

cards.prompt: What is Sun Kil Moon's acclaimed 2014 album?
cards.details: Often called his masterpiece: plain-spoken, diary-like songs that hit very hard.

cards.prompt: Benji is famous for frank, diary-like songs about family and what heavy subject?
cards.details: Relatives, strangers and news stories: a whole album confronting how suddenly people can be gone.

cards.prompt: The Benji song "Ben's My Friend" is about which Death Cab for Cutie singer?
cards.details: A rambling, funny, self-deprecating song about middle age, friendship and envy.

cards.prompt: Later Sun Kil Moon records moved towards long, rambling songs in which vocal style?
cards.details: Songs began to read like stream-of-consciousness journals, sometimes more than ten minutes long.

cards.prompt: What is Sun Kil Moon's 2015 album, released the year after Benji?
cards.details: Even longer, looser songs, which divided fans who'd loved Benji.

cards.prompt: Which project led by Justin Broadrick made a joint album with Sun Kil Moon in 2016?
cards.details: An unlikely pairing: Broadrick's heavy, droning electronics under Kozelek's spoken-word storytelling.

cards.prompt: Mark Kozelek played the bassist of the fictional band Stillwater in which 2000 film?
cards.details: Cameron Crowe, the film's director, was a longtime fan of his music.
